## Problemstellung

```{r}
#| label: lese_geo

data_folder <- "C:/Users/lochmannm/Documents/SourceFFR/data/"
ni_path <-
  paste0(data_folder, "NeuIsenburg/Betrachte FasP.gdb")
isen_gkz<-"438009"

layers_neuIsenburg<-sf::st_layers(ni_path)
hk <- sf::st_read(ni_path, layer = "Hauskoordinaten_NeuIsenburg") |>
  sf::st_set_crs(25832)
flurstuecke <- sf::st_read(ni_path, layer = "Flurstücke_NeuIsenburg") |>
  sf::st_set_crs(25832)

```

```{r}
#| label: fassadenpunkte
fasp_folder <-
  paste0(data_folder, "FasP/")

shp_fasp_files <- data.frame(
  files=list.files(path = fasp_folder, pattern = "\\.shp$", full.names = TRUE)
) 

print(shp_fasp_files)
```


